announcements.headline: PureTech Health Wins 2026 Prix Galien USA Award
announcements.insight: This award validates the clinical progress of SPTX and Gallop pipelines detailed in October. It serves as positive validation rather than a direct financial event for shareholders.

announcements.headline: PRTC's Celea Appoints Paul Audhya, MD, MBA, as CMO
announcements.insight: Celea appoints a new CMO. This follows Gallop's recent positive FDA meeting and SPTX's Phase 2a trial initiation, suggesting continued operational momentum across the group.

announcements.headline: PRTC's Gallop Presents Ph1b LYT-200 Data at ESMO
announcements.insight: Following the October presentation of Phase 1 GlyphAgo data, Gallop presents Ph1b LYT-200 data at ESMO. This updates progress on a programme previously granted Fast Track status by the FDA.

announcements.headline: PRTC's Gallop to Present Ph1b LYT-200 Data at ESMO
announcements.insight: Gallop presents Phase 1b data at ESMO. This follows positive FDA feedback in September and Fast Track designation, indicating continued clinical progression.

announcements.headline: PRTC's SPTX Presents Phase 1 GlyphAgo Data at ECNP
announcements.insight: SPTX presents Phase 1 GlyphAgo data at ECNP, following the Phase 2a trial initiation in October. This updates progress on a key asset.

announcements.headline: PRTC's SPTX: Phase 2a Trial of GlyphAgo Initiated
announcements.insight: The initiation of the Phase 2a trial for GlyphAgo marks a new clinical milestone. This follows recent positive developments in other programs, including Celea and Gallop.

announcements.headline: PRTC's Gallop: Positive FDA Meeting & Fast Track
announcements.insight: Fast Track status for Celea follows the Phase 3 start in July, potentially accelerating the regulatory pathway and de-risking the upcoming results due in September.

announcements.headline: Notice of Results
announcements.insight: This notice confirms upcoming results for Celea, following its Phase 3 dosing in July. Shareholders should await the data release to assess clinical progress.

announcements.headline: PRTC's Celea:2 Deupirfenidone Presentations at ERS
announcements.insight: Following the July Phase 3 initiation, these presentations update shareholder visibility on Celea clinical progress without disclosing new financial terms or outcomes.

announcements.headline: PDMR Notification RSU Vesting
announcements.insight: Director vesting of restricted stock units follows recent capital raising and trial progress. This routine equity event does not alter the strategic trajectory outlined in July announcements.

announcements.headline: PRTC: Celea Doses 1st Patient in Phase 3 IPF Trial
announcements.insight: Celea advances to Phase 3 IPF trial dosing, following its July launch. This validates the asset transfer and syndicate backing.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. They do not alter the strategic progress from the recent Celea launch and SPTX data.

announcements.headline: PRTC Launches Celea w/ $180M & Top Tier Syndicate
announcements.insight: Celea launches with $180M funding following June dosing data. This asset transfer marks a significant capital raise and strategic step for shareholders.

announcements.headline: PRTC Launches Celea: $180M & Asset Transfer
announcements.insight: Asset transfer and launch of Celea follow recent positive Phase 1 data. This strategic move may alter the company's development pipeline.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. This follows the June SPTX Phase 1 data update.

announcements.headline: PRTC's SPTX: New Positive GlyphAgo Ph1 Dosing Data
announcements.insight: Positive Phase 1 dosing data for GlyphAgo suggests clinical progress. This milestone may influence future valuation and development timelines for shareholders.
